company.name: SaturnX
company.shortDescription: SaturnX enables businesses and financial institutions to move money globally through an API-first platform.
company.description: SaturnX is a stablecoin payments infrastructure company that enables businesses and financial institutions to move money globally through an API-first platform that leverages stablecoin liquidity, smart FX routing, and regulatory-compliant payout networks. SaturnX supports cross-border payments in major remittance corridors and is rapidly expanding into Southeast Asia and Africa.

productsAndServices.description: A stablecoin-based payments infrastructure enabling global money transfers through blockchain technology.
productsAndServices.name: SaturnX Payments powered by Stablecoins

productsAndServices.description: An API layer that accepts fiat or stablecoins, converts or swaps assets across blockchains, and disburses funds in local currencies or bank accounts.
productsAndServices.name: Universal Conversion Layer

productsAndServices.description: A developer-friendly REST API with real-time webhooks for quick integration of SaturnX’s payment infrastructure into existing systems.
productsAndServices.name: Seamless API Integration

productsAndServices.description: A real-time dashboard for tracking balances, monitoring payouts, and generating reports within the SaturnX payment system.
productsAndServices.name: Powerful Dashboard for Total Control
